newsitem.title: USA: Allergan gets FDA approval for ACULAR.
newsitem.headline: Allergan gets FDA approval for ACULAR.

text.p: Allergan Inc said Monday it has received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market ACULAR 0.5 percent in the U.S. for the treatment of postoperative inflammation in patients who have undergone cataract extraction.
The company said in a statement an estimated 1.6 million cataract surgeries are performed in the U.S. each year.
"ACULAR has been one of the top growth products in our ophthalmic pharmaceutical business," said Allergan Chairman and Chief Executive Officer William Shepherd.
"This new indication should strengthen its market position," he added.

Last month Allergan filed the application for U.S. marketing approval for ocular pain following incisional refractive surgery. In November 1992, ACULAR received FDA marketing clearance for the relief of ocular itch associated with seasonal allergic conjunctivitis.
